title: Fund your team kits with sponsors & fundraising
meta_title: Fund Team Kits: Sponsors & Fundraising | MOMUTO
meta_descript: Fund your football kits with sponsors and fundraising: printed sponsor logos at no extra cost, splitting the cost across the squad, and quantity discounts.
summary: How grassroots teams pay for kit: local sponsors with logos printed in at no extra cost, what a sponsor gets, and fundraising when there’s no sponsor.
content:
Quick answer

Most teams don’t pay for kit out of pocket — they fund it with sponsors and fundraising. Sublimation prints a sponsor’s logo into the fabric at no extra cost, and one local sponsor often covers a large part of a squad order. No minimum order.

Sponsors: the usual way to pay for kit

A local pub, garage, estate agent or family business will often sponsor a grassroots team in exchange for their logo on the shirt. Sublimation prints that logo on the chest, sleeves or back — permanently, with no extra cost per logo. Design it in the 3D configurator or with a designer.

What a sponsor gets

Every match, every photo, every league write-up carries the logo. It is cheap, local advertising with goodwill attached — which is exactly why so many small businesses say yes. Offer chest for the main sponsor, sleeves and back for smaller ones.

Fundraising when there’s no sponsor

No sponsor yet? Split the cost across the squad (there’s no minimum order, so each player can pay for their own jersey), run a small fundraiser, or sell a few extra jerseys to supporters and family. The per-jersey price drops with quantity, so a bigger order is cheaper per shirt.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a sponsor logo cost to add?

Nothing extra. Sublimation prints every logo into the fabric at no additional cost, whether you have one sponsor or several.

Where can sponsor logos go?

Chest, sleeves and back. A common setup is a main sponsor on the chest and smaller ones on the sleeves or back.

Can each player pay for their own jersey?

Yes — there is no minimum order, so you can split the order across the squad and still get the quantity discount.
